title: Application for tax break on Bronx affordable housing rehab
summary: This application would grant a property tax exemption under Section 577 of the Private Housing Finance Law for buildings at four Bronx sites being rehabilitated as part of the MHANY Cluster 2.NR Rehab project. The exemption would run for up to seven years from an effective date of February 4, 2020, so long as the property remains owned by a qualifying housing development fund company and complies with its regulatory agreement with the Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
